layers.name: UI/app-server evidence
observes: requires independent screenshot or direct model/safetyBuffering/updated capture; not inferred from MCP

classification_contract.tool_active: fresh MCP traffic and/or live connector child
classification_contract.tool_plane_silent: no fresh MCP traffic and zero live connector children; backend/model state remains unknown
classification_contract.stronger_transport_stall_evidence: matching turn/thread emits `idle timeout waiting for SSE` or websocket idle-timeout/error; still inspect retry/recovery before causal claim
classification_contract.safety_buffering: must be established from visible UI or app-server/Responses safety-buffering evidence
classification_contract.model_reroute: must be established separately from model/rerouted evidence

auto_mapping.method: Use latest target process receipt start time plus distinctive command tokens to search retained Codex feedback logs for a unique thread_id candidate.
auto_mapping.reason: No retained local Codex rows matched the Owl receipt terms in its +/-20 second window.
auto_mapping.warning: A no-match is not evidence that the MCP caller lacked a model turn; the MCP caller may belong to a different client/runtime or the relevant logs may be absent/pruned.

banner_lifecycle_rule.rule: Banner visibility is not a stall clock.
banner_lifecycle_rule.source_basis: Exact v0.153.1 test keeps banner visible after assistant text output and clears it only on turn completion.
banner_lifecycle_rule.capture_requirement: Record UI banner state, MCP activity, live-child state, assistant-output onset, Responses events, and turn completion as separate timestamps.

ui_visibility_caveat.presence: proves the generic banner was rendered at that instant; does not prove stall or specific reason/useCase
ui_visibility_caveat.absence: does not prove no underlying safetyBuffering payload because per-turn/permanent dismissal can hide it
ui_visibility_caveat.recommended_capture: record whether banner-dismiss controls/preferences were used when relying on visual negative evidence

watcher.default_start: current transport EOF and, if thread-id supplied, current max thread log id
safety_properties: does not consume incomplete final transport line

probe_v2.backend_model_state: always unknown absent independent Responses evidence

identity_semantics.caller_id: stable pseudonymous connector identity; not model-worker identity
identity_semantics.same_caller_session: classify as same connector fingerprint only unless direct thread/turn/Responses/process evidence supplies stronger continuity
